applicabilityBasis.summary: sirloinUSDC represents a yield-accruing USDC-denominated lending-vault position with variable assets per share and liquidity-dependent withdrawals. The opened product and protocol disclosures establish a strategy share rather than a fixed-value payment or settlement instrument or an issuer obligation to redeem for a fixed amount of monetary value under GENIUS Act section 2(22).

genius.notes: Assessment as of 2026-10-07 applies to the vault share separately from underlying USDC. Carniceria Tropical SA is identified in current terms as the Panama service operator and vault curator; the opened materials do not establish it, Steakhouse Financial Ltd, Circle, Ethena, or Zama as a separate legal payment-stablecoin issuer for this share. issuerEntity is therefore omitted consistently across these vault variants. Redemption follows smart-contract asset/share accounting and available strategy liquidity, without a fixed-dollar issuer promise. No GENIUS issuer authorization, foreign registration, or issuer pathway is asserted. Underlying USDC reserve reports and authorizations are not vault-level attestations or authorizations. This scope assessment does not determine the application of securities law or authorize distribution of the yield product.
